sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Words that say when come first in the sentence: *Reggel olvasok.* means “In the morning I read.” With a place too, the order is time, place, verb: *Délután a parkban sétálok.*

items.english: In the afternoon I walk in the park.
Do you cook in the evening?

sections.content: These words take no ending. You know *reggel* and *este* from the greetings *jó reggelt* and *jó estét*.
